data.title: 樱岛麻衣 · 晨间厨房
data.description: 【樱岛麻衣 · 晨间厨房】清晨的阳光斜洒在干净明亮的厨房台面上，系着淡色围裙的麻衣正熟练地煎着溏心荷包蛋，平底锅里发出滋滋的诱人声响。她听见你睡眼惺忪的脚步声，微微侧头轻笑——「洗脸刷牙了吗？快去坐好，热腾腾的味噌汤和早餐马上就准备好了。」
data.action: 一手扶平底锅柄，另一手持锅铲，听见脚步后微微回头笑
data.camera: medium shot, preparing breakfast at kitchen counter
data.promptProse: With one hand on the frying-pan handle and the other holding a spatula, Mai turns gently toward footsteps at the kitchen doorway. A light apron covers her long-sleeved knit top and skirt, black hair tied away from the cooking area. The medium view includes the egg, prepared dishes and soup bowl along the counter. Morning window light reaches the pan rim and her cheek, leaving soft shadows beneath the bowls.
